_cache_miss_note: A cache miss under AIP_OFFLINE=1 means the config under test is not the one the cache was recorded against. Treated as a zero-quality answer, not an exception.
_latency_caveat: Wall clock on a cache-replaying machine. Under AIP_OFFLINE=1 a cache hit costs 0 ms, so this measures code + retrieval + cache lookup, NOT provider latency. The deployed p95 is in EVALUATION_REPORT.md from an online run.
